minecraft:written_book_content.title: Containment Report 14
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Dr. Hallow
pages: {"text":"The glass held. The locks held. The subject was not inside the chamber when the lights returned."}
{"text":"There were wet footprints on the observation side of the glass."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. A field report from the last outpost mentions a glass room and a subject that was never logged. The report carries the same three-stroke mark."}
